Trouble gathered at the tail. The top tip was too sharp a corner, so Priya bridged it round while Tom cleared the old back edge and filled its middle. The crossing, where body met tail, proved the hardest joint. Priya bridged one side, then Leo cleared the jammed middle and re-laid it while the others kept their hands off. As time ran low, he was still laying it: "Still laying the crossing, nearly there." The team finished with 91 of 140 fallen.
